decisions.decision: The test supplies an AuditSink bean (DataAuthorizationAutoConfiguration needs one, as in AdminSurfaceMvcTest); -Dtest must not be used to select it, since that also runs it in the default execution, which has web-core.

AdminObjectNotFoundException also extended LocalizedException and is thrown by OperationEvaluator (line 135) on every surface; the design missed it. Same treatment: extends SecurityRefusalException, SecurityProblemMapper renders it NOT_FOUND. Found by the without-web-core run (NoClassDefFoundError constructing OperationEvaluator). AdminApprovalException and InvalidAdminRequestException stay LocalizedException: admin surface only, which requires web-core, and OperationEvaluator does not link them.
AdminSurfaceGuardTest asserts e.code() instead of e.toDefinition().code(): toDefinition was LocalizedException's; the asserted code is unchanged.
SecurityRefusalException stores properties with Map.copyOf, as LocalizedException.getProperties did; ProblemDefinition copies them the same way, so the rendered body is unchanged.
SecurityProblemMapperTest.rendersTheRefusals pins status, code, args and properties of all three refusals (the new mapping branch).
